contexts.text: That the Lord overcame all kinds of persuasions of what is false, which are the Emim, etc.
They smote... the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim () = the persuasions of what is false, or the Hells of such, which the Lord conquered... The Emim, etc., were of a similar kind to the Nephilim.
Hence it is that Moab drove out the Emim... by the Emim, etc., are signified those who are imbued with persuasions of what is evil and false.
